result.summary: Sets a default socket timeout on test HTTP connections using the node's RPC timeout configuration. It also reworks HTTP 413 tests in interface_http.py to verify that the server closes the connection rather than expecting a guaranteed response code on a terminated socket.
result.problem: Socket timeouts in BitcoinHTTPConnection were unset or reset to None, allowing functional tests to hang indefinitely if a connection stalled. Furthermore, existing HTTP 413 test assertions made flawed assumptions about connection behavior when sending oversized requests.
evidence: Author states this "should help to debug/fix https://github.com/hebasto/bitcoin-core-nightly/issues/368, but seems independently useful to avoid unbounded-time test runs" (description).
result.scope_notes: Modifies only the test framework file interface_http.py.
result.card: Sets a default socket timeout in BitcoinHTTPConnection to the node's RPC timeout, preventing functional test runs from hanging indefinitely. Also reworks HTTP 413 tests in interface_http.py to assert that the server closes the connection instead of assuming a response read will succeed on an aborted socket. The change addresses test hangs seen in nightly test runs (hebasto/bitcoin-core-nightly#368).

risk.why: Only touches functional test harness code and test assertions; a bug would only cause test failures or flaky tests.
